instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.dat`. Then write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\yield.json` with `runs`, `passing`, and `yield` for the stepped corners whose `V(OUT)` stays within `5.050 V +/- 0.008 V`. The JSON must be derived from the native stepped measurements in `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v_measure.txt`. [Software] Launch OrCAD Capture with `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\capture.exe` (adjust to your Cadence install root).
